Eternal September is a meme from 1993 when AOL opened up Usenet to the public. Before then, when college kids hooked up to Usenet, you had to learn the ropes, the etiquette, the lingo. After that, it was a free-for-all and the things that made Usenet good got washed out by the massive influx of new users. It is Eternal September specifically because every September, new college kids would start their semester and be shown how to hook up to Usenet. This small influx was met with ire, but the big influx in 1993 made it a permanent large influx.

I referenced Eternal September because reddit has a huge amount of new users and the admin and mods have done nothing to maintain the original integrity of what the site once was.
